findings.title: Criteria 1–5 and 7 trace to tasks, and sequencing has no cycles
findings.description: `isChecked` is derived as `=== 'x'`, so `~` stays unchecked, which matches Task 3. Criteria 1–2 map to Tasks 1–3 and 5. Criterion 3 maps to Tasks 4–5. Criterion 4 maps to Tasks 9–10. Criterion 5 maps to Tasks 8 and 11. Criterion 7 maps to Tasks 2 and 5. Dependencies run in order from 1 to 13 with no back-references.

findings.title: Criterion 6 names arch-status-vs-plans, and no task tests it
findings.description: Criterion 6 requires that neither `plan-status-vs-entries` nor `arch-status-vs-plans` false-positive on a `[~]` plan. Task 12 (task file lines 199–212) adds cases only for `plan-status-vs-entries`. The arch rule uses the same aggregate (`ConsistencyChecker.ts:828`, `completedSlices === totalSlices`), so Decision 3 affects it too. Add Task 12 cases for the arch rule in both directions: `status: complete` with all entries resolved produces no finding, and `in-progress` with all entries resolved still fires.

findings.title: Extending the shared fixture changes consumers the tasks do not list
findings.description: Task 1 extends `sample-slice-plan.md`. That file is also read by `overviewParser.test.ts:20`, `ArtifactIntrospector.test.ts:86`, and several cases in `futureWorkParser.test.ts`. Task 5 then edits the existing totals from 5/3 to 7/5 (task file lines 95–98). That conflicts with the design's requirement that existing fixture tests "pass unchanged." The design allows a sibling fixture. Use one, such as `sample-slice-plan-deprecated.md`, so the existing fixture and its consumers stay byte-identical. If the shared fixture is kept, Task 1 must name those consumers and require their suites to run.

findings.title: Task 9 adds an initializer change that never takes effect
findings.description: Task 9 (task file lines 155–163) changes the `derivedStatus` initializer at `slice.ts:91` because a filesystem error would otherwise report `not-started`. The catch block at `slice.ts:125-127` sets `'degraded'` on any throw, so the initializer's value never reaches the output. The step is dead code built on a wrong rationale, and the design does not call for it. Remove it.

findings.title: Task 9 misses a short-circuit that runs before deriveEntryStatus
findings.description: When task or frontmatter resolution fails, the ternary returns `'degraded'` before `deriveEntryStatus()` runs. Decision 4 places `planLineStatus` at the top precedence tier, but this branch bypasses it. A `[~]` entry whose task file or design frontmatter is unreadable would show `degraded` instead of `⊘ deprecated`. Task 9 should check for deprecated ahead of this ternary, or the task should state the deviation. Task 10 should add a malformed-task-file case to lock the behavior in.

findings.title: ProjectModelBuilder.ts:445 is a third deriveEntryStatus call site that the design and tasks omit
findings.description: Planned-but-unwritten slices are built with `deriveEntryStatus({ isChecked: entry.isChecked })`. Once Tasks 2–3 emit `[~]` entries, they will show here as `not-started`, while `cf list slices` shows `deprecated`. Decision 4 names only WorkflowNavigator and `cf list slices`. Either add the same `planLineStatus` line here with a test, or list it as out of scope with the reason. I did not trace the project model's consumers, so the user-visible impact is unverified.

findings.title: Tasks 2–4 and 11–12 are split finer than their size
findings.description: Tasks 2 (regex class), 3 (status assignment in two branches), and 4 (one filter change) are one- or two-line edits. Their tests land only in Task 5, so the test-with pattern is delayed across three tasks. Merge Tasks 2–4 into one parser task, followed by Task 5. Tasks 11 and 12 are each a single test case with their own commit. They could share one commit or be folded into Task 10.

findings.title: Commit markers are written as checkboxes
findings.description: The commit markers at lines 105, 135, 179, 197, 212, and 225 are `- [ ] Commit:` checkboxes. The convention is plain `**Commit**:` lines, never checkboxes. Task 13's commit (line 225) is also conditional ("if any uncommitted changes remain"), which an implementer can skip or misread. Make it an unconditional marker or remove it.

findings.title: The planLineStatus ternary is duplicated across Tasks 8 and 9
findings.description: Tasks 8 and 9 both specify `entry.status === STATUS.Deprecated ? STATUS.Deprecated : undefined`. The design accepts this because the signal gathering is already duplicated. A single exported helper in `statusDerivation.ts` would keep the rule in one place if you want to avoid adding to the duplication.
